pr492_inverse_truncation.reuse_policy: Compile this byte-identical source once as an import dependency; do not rerun the historical four-axis campaign or review. Preserve CAS_CONFLICT_PRESERVED, published R1 evidence, and scientific HOLD.

norms.vector: Imported NonlinearRemainder.eNorm, the Euclidean norm through WithLp.toLp 2

definition_signatures: abbrev H (D : M3) : ℝ := CAS03C03.H D
abbrev sigma (D : M3) : M3 := CAS03C03.sigma D
def toCol (v : V3) : CAS03C03.V := fun i _ => v i
def fromCol (v : CAS03C03.V) : V3 := fun i => v i 0
def linearSignal (D : M3) (beta : V3) : V3 := (-2 : ℝ) • D.mulVec beta
def exactEstimate (D : M3) (h : V3) : V3 := (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) • (D⁻¹).mulVec h
def truncEstimate (D : M3) (hH : H D ≠ 0) (h : V3) : V3 := fromCol (CAS03C03.betaTrunc D hH (toCol h))
def linearDefect (D : M3) (_hH : H D ≠ 0) (beta : V3) : V3 := (1 / (H D)^2) • ((sigma D * sigma D).mulVec beta)
def truncGain (D : M3) (_hH : H D ≠ 0) : ℝ := (1 + opNorm (sigma D) / |H D|) / (2 * |H D|)

branch_assumptions.exact_inverse: D.det != 0; symmetry and subluminal/radius assumptions enter only when consuming the nonlinear remainder bound
branch_assumptions.truncation: H D != 0; this does not imply D.det != 0 and does not assert small shear
branch_assumptions.zero_H_control: D can be invertible with H D = 0; exact inverse remains available but betaTrunc/trunc_defect is unavailable
